`plastic-water-bottle.jpg` is an original code-drawn sample image of a capped plastic water bottle with a blue label, created for Pixelogy regression testing. It contains no real person's photo or metadata. Integration tests mock Gemini's response explicitly, while exercising the real token-verification adapter, per-user scan reservation, receipt signing and 200-item catalog matcher. A separate SQL rollback test verifies authenticated bottle persistence and RLS. This is not evidence of live Gemini vision accuracy or a physical camera test.
